institutionName: UiT The Arctic University of Norway

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer:
Tromsø was a totally different environment than what I am used to. It allowed me to experience huge contrast between my home and my exchange home. 

Furthermore staying in the Artic made it posible for me to focus on an Artic perspective regarding my education which focusses on environmental change and how we preserve our natural ressources. The Arctiv is one of those places on Earth where the climate change is accelerating and must noticable which made me choose Tromsø as a destination of interest.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer:
It was very very bad. 

First of all I study Natural Resources at Copenhagen University which is a mix of natural science and social science. I was allocated to the science faculty of UiT which only had high level cources of chemistry, physics and biology none which I have the proper compentences to apply for. 
I was told that it was only possible to have cources at one faculty, (which I later found out was a lie), and that forced me to pick cources which was mostly irrelevant for my kind of bachelor degree.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Mussta, the exchange coordinator, was the reason I was very unsatisfied with my selection of cources. He had no really interest in helping the incoming exchange students, which a lot of other exchange students also experienced.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer:
My original? Unsuccesful

My irrelevant 4th priorities cources? 100% succes

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be early and be stubborn because things will work out, but the timefactor can make you pick cources you do not want becauce the exchange coordinator is not helpfull and stressing you.
